result.summary: The page renders mostly correctly, but there is a clear data-formatting bug in the 'Fastest near you' row (€NaN delivery) plus several smaller layout/styling inconsistencies around truncated card titles and mismatched favorite-button styling.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card shows '€NaN delivery', indicating an unparsed/undefined delivery fee value leaking into the UI.
issues.suggestion: Validate the delivery-fee value before formatting; fall back to a placeholder like '—' or hide the line when the number is missing/NaN.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is clipped mid-title ('Trattoria Piccol') with no ellipsis or visible peek affordance, so it reads as broken text rather than scrollable content.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with ellipsis to card titles and ensure the carousel shows a consistent partial-card peek with proper horizontal padding.

issues.description: Favorite (heart) buttons are inconsistent: the ramen card uses a white circle with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card uses a dark circle with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button style (same background, icon color, and size) across all restaurant cards, or reserve the filled variant strictly for the 'favorited' state.

issues.description: The first card in 'Fastest near you' has a light gray image background while the other two are dark, making the row look visually uneven.
issues.suggestion: Normalize image aspect ratio/background treatment (or add a consistent gradient overlay) so all carousel thumbnails match.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card is cut off by the bottom tab bar, hiding its name, rating, and delivery info without any indication that more content follows.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scroll container equal to the tab bar height so the last card can be fully revealed on scroll.
